categories.name: Skills and keywords
categories.measures: Required and preferred skills, tools and terms from the JD that appear in the CV.
categories.scoring: Required JD keywords count 2, preferred count 1; score = 100 x matched points / total points. A keyword matches when the CV contains it as a whole word or phrase, ignoring case. No keywords gives 100.

categories.name: Experience relevance
categories.measures: Years of experience, seniority and domain compared with what the JD asks for.
categories.scoring: Start at 100; -10 per year short (max 40); -10 seniority one level below, -25 two or more; -10 adjacent domain, -25 different; -10 per other unmet experience requirement (max 30).

categories.name: Achievements and impact
categories.measures: Share of experience bullets that state a measurable outcome.
categories.scoring: 100 x experience bullets with a measurable outcome / all experience bullets. Counts of activities and vague claims are not outcomes. No bullets gives 0.

categories.name: Education and certifications
categories.measures: Degree, field of study and certifications the JD requires or prefers.
categories.scoring: Start at 100; -15 per unmet preferred item; any unmet required item caps the score at 40. No education requirements gives 100.

categories.name: Structure and clarity
categories.measures: Standard sections present, dated roles, concise bullets a reader can scan.
categories.scoring: From the CV text alone: start at 100; -15 per missing section (summary or profile, experience, skills, education); -20 when no role carries a year; -5 per experience bullet over 250 characters (max 20).
